description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura  District - Cad. Map No. 620274 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
